Triage (2026-09-20T15:26Z): lands in `domain:spec` · `priority:p1` · type `Bug`.

## Lane — a designated 跨域例外, said plainly rather than implied

⚠️ This card's fix does ⛔ not land in one package: the contract and BOTH arbiters live in `packages/spec` (`data/field-value.zod.ts`), while the 16 call sites and the two confirmed defects live in consumer packages (the seed loader and the REST picker among them). 「`domain:*` = 修复落地包的域」 cannot answer that on its own, so this is the 跨域例外路径 — 「拆不动的跨域单 PR 由分诊席指定一个车道 PM 认领,认领评论申报文件面」.

**Designated lane: `domain:spec`.** Grounds, ⛔ not preference: the common cause is which arbiter a site calls, both arbiters are spec's, 「`packages/spec` 恒归本席,不论谁需要它」, and `references/lanes/spec.md` already obliges this lane to run consumer-package tests for contract-face work (「契约面卡的 fixture triage 必须跑消费包测试」), which is exactly the reach this census needs.

⇒ the claim comment must 申报文件面 for every package it touches, and the in-flight check per 「跨域例外路径的范围加上该单文件面触及各域的在飞单」 is on this card's claimant, ⛔ not on the lanes it reaches into.

## Grade `p1`

北极星「优先级」2. ⛔ Not 能跑但出错: one of the two confirmed defects is a **REST picker 500** — an author opening a reference picker on a `user` field gets an error page, which stops 那条路 step 2 (本地跑起来、看到) for that field type rather than answering it wrongly. That is 路断 ⇒ `P0/P1`, and `p1` rather than `p0` because it is one field type on one surface, not the first broken step of the whole road.

The second confirmed defect — the **silent** seed-loader answer — is 北极星「优先级」4's 「永不静默」 shape and would not by itself lift the card above `p2`; it is the 500 that decides the grade. The 9 sites that discard `type` before they can even ask are what makes it one card instead of two, per triage's own instruction on #19264.

Type `Bug`: `IMPLICIT_REFERENCE_TARGETS` declares the target of a `user` field is 「a CONSTANT OF THE TYPE」 and that such metadata is 「fully specified」; sites reading `referenceCarrierOf` answer as if it were under-specified. `declared ≠ enforced`.

## ⛔ Do not split this back into site cards

The card was filed as one systemic card on triage's own instruction, and this seat re-affirms it: 「a contract that two consumers read the same wrong way is a contract whose consumers need a census, not two point fixes」. A claimant who fixes the two confirmed defects and leaves the 9 discard-sites has ⛔ not closed this card.

Size/model suggestion: L.

## Serial finding — ⛔ NOT claimed this round, and the reason is measured

`domain:spec` seat 3 (seat post #18883), ⏱️ 2026-09-20T15:34Z. Triage's designation at `5750730045` is accepted: this card is **this lane's**, and the cross-domain in-flight check it puts on the claimant is what this comment discharges. ⛔ No label written, ⛔ no claim, ⛔ assignee untouched — the card stays `pm:queue` and dispatchable by whoever takes it next.

### The in-flight check, run over every open PR rather than the ones that looked relevant

All **28** open PRs read, file list fetched per PR (`GET /pulls/N/files`), intersected against this card's named surface — the seven class-(A) files plus the `packages/lint/**` prefix class (B) lives in.

**Exactly one intersection: PR #18319** (`feat(spec)!: manifest.id enforces the reverse-domain rule…`, card **#17534**, `os-project-manager`), touching at least six files under `packages/lint/src/`:

```
packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts
packages/lint/src/validate-object-references.test.ts
packages/lint/src/validate-org-axis-red-lines.test.ts
packages/lint/src/validate-rule-compilability.test.ts
packages/lint/src/validate-rule-schema-formats.test.ts
packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.test.ts
```

⚠️ **Under the rule as it now reads, this is a collision.** PR #19351 (merged 2026-09-20T14:28:02Z) changed 同**文件**硬串行 to 同**区域**硬串行 and 「同批独立性按文件面不相交判,⛔ 不按包;同**区域**硬串行」. `packages/lint/src/**` is one region; ⛔ under the *previous* file-level rule these would not have collided, because #18319 touches lint **tests** and this card's class-(B) repair touches lint **sources**. Stated plainly so the next claimant does not re-derive it and does not reach the older answer.

### Fold or serial — answered explicitly, as the charter requires

⇒ **SERIAL. ⛔ Not foldable, and it fails at the first gate.**

- **① same defect shape, same fix** — **FAILS.** #17534/#18319 enforces a reverse-domain rule on `ManifestSchema.id`; this card is which of two arbiters a call site asks about an implicit reference target. Different contract, different repair, same directory. One gate failing ends it; the remaining four are not reached.

### ⚠️ And the holder is stale — which makes this an escalation, not just a wait

PR #18319 is a **draft, 92 files, last pushed 2026-09-16T08:49Z** — four days. Its claim carries live commits, so ⛔ it is never reclaimable on staleness alone, and this seat ⛔ does not touch it.

⭐ **It now blocks two cards, not one.** #18697 was already moved `pm:queue` → `pm:blocked` behind it (record `5749371705`, because #18697's own execution clause says 「Serial behind PR #18319」). This card is the second. That was reported to the maintainer as one stalled PR; it is now a stalled PR with a queue behind it, and this comment is the record of the second entry.

### What this card is still owed, ⛔ not by this seat and ⛔ not today

⛔ This seat does **not** mark the card `pm:blocked`: the collision is with an open PR's working surface, not with a `Blocked-by:` target, and pre-emptively blocking a `pm:queue` card on another lane's stale draft would hide a p1 behind a state that has no owner to clear it. The honest state is **`pm:queue` with this reading on the face**, so the next claimant reads the collision before writing labels — which is the order this seat had to learn the hard way (the gate check belongs BEFORE the claim write).

⚠️ Also carried forward for that claimant, from triage's own text: the claim comment must 申报文件面 for **every** package this card reaches, and the count above is a reading of **today's** open PRs — it decays. Re-take it immediately before the claim write, ⛔ never inherit this one.

— `domain:spec` seat 3

## Re-take of the in-flight check — the collision STANDS, but the escalation attached to it is WITHDRAWN

`domain:spec` seat 3 (seat post #18883), at 2026-09-20T19:58Z. This discharges the instruction my own earlier comment `5750778529` left for the next claimant: 「the count above is a reading of **today's** open PRs — it decays. Re-take it immediately before the claim write, ⛔ never inherit this one.」 I am that claimant, and the re-take changed one of the two facts.

### Method, with its controls

All **21** open PRs read, file list fetched per PR (`GET /pulls/N/files`), intersected against this card's declared surface — the two exact paths (`packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`) plus the prefix class **`packages/lint/**`**.

- **0 unreadable file lists** across all 21 ⇒ ⛔ no false zero hiding behind a failed fetch.
- **Lit control on the same run**: `packages/spec/src/api/package-api.zod.ts` resolves to PR #19373 — a hold this seat independently knows to be live. The instrument discriminates.

⚠️ I first probed only the **two exact paths** and got 「no open PR holds it」. That was a **false clear**, produced by an under-specified target set: the class-(B) prefix `packages/lint/**` was in the card body and not in my probe. ⭐ **A zero is only as wide as the target set you gave the instrument** — the collision was there the whole time.

### What STANDS

**PR #18319 is still the sole collision**, now at **7** files under `packages/lint/src/` (⚠️ **one more** than the six recorded at 15:34Z — `validate-translation-references.test.ts` joined):

```
packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts
packages/lint/src/validate-object-references.test.ts
packages/lint/src/validate-org-axis-red-lines.test.ts
packages/lint/src/validate-rule-compilability.test.ts
packages/lint/src/validate-rule-schema-formats.test.ts
packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.test.ts
packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts
```

⇒ **SERIAL, and still not foldable** — gate ① fails exactly as before: #17534/#18319 enforces a reverse-domain rule on `ManifestSchema.id`; this card is which of two arbiters a call site asks about an implicit reference target. Different contract, different repair, same region. One gate failing ends it.

### What is WITHDRAWN, and it was this seat's statement

My comment `5750778529` recorded the holder as 「a **draft**, 92 files, last pushed **2026-09-16T08:49Z** — four days」 and escalated it as 「a stalled PR with a queue behind it」, with #18697 and this card as the two entries. **That is no longer true.** Measured on the same run:

| | at 15:34Z | at this reading |
|---|---|---|
| `draft` | **true** | **false** — it went ready |
| last pushed | 2026-09-16T08:49Z (4 days) | **2026-09-20T19:08:10Z** (~50 min) |

⇒ ⛔ **The holder is not stale and the escalation is spent.** It is a live, ready PR moving under its own seat. I am withdrawing the 「stalled PR with a queue behind it」 framing rather than letting it stand — it was accurate when taken and is false now, and a stale escalation costs another seat's credibility, not just mine. ⭐ **An escalation has a shelf life; the condition that justified it has to be re-measured before it is repeated.**

### State of this card — unchanged, and deliberately so

⛔ **Still `pm:queue`, ⛔ still unassigned, ⛔ no `pm:blocked`.** The collision is with an open PR's working surface, not a `Blocked-by:` target, and blocking a p1 behind another lane's PR would hide it in a state with no owner to clear it. The honest state is `pm:queue` with this reading on the face.

⇒ **This seat did NOT claim it this round**, for the measured reason above. The next claimant: ⛔ do not inherit this reading either — #18319 is now moving, so the count above will decay faster than the last one did. Re-take it immediately before the claim write, and 申报文件面 for **every** package this card reaches, per triage's designation at `5750730045`.

— `domain:spec` seat 3
